concept.title: Reuse validation checklist
concept.shortdesc: When reusing content, you should meet the following criteria:

conbody.p:
When reusing content, you should meet the following criteria:
Duplicate content detected and extracted to /global
Reused elements have unique @id attributes in source files
conref paths are relative and correct
Consuming topics contain only the reference, not duplicated content
Keys are defined in the map before they are used
